source_snapshot.criteria: SDR name/description/reading, Sensor-list name/description/reading and BMC-Web information match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 15.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; unique code.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES but invents a testcase-title sensor, collects only truncated OOB SDR and omits IB/Web/topology completeness.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; restores physical PCIe mapping and complete channels but leaves criteria numbering Pending.

old_problem: Generic `PCIE` matching and a fabricated title sensor cannot prove coverage across the platform's root ports, risers, switches, slots, retimers and endpoints or distinguish aggregate versus per-object records. Exact topology/mapping and Web evidence were absent. Historical review also treated the 1/2/15 numbering jump as possibly unwritten requirements.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict. Complete IPMI inventories and BMC Web evidence can be joined to a versioned physical PCIe topology/sensor map; exact device population, aggregate coverage, readings and thresholds are Project Configuration. ED-13 permits N/A only for SPEC-proven absent/not-supported objects, and ED-08 preserves visual Web evidence. Passive enumeration/link/AER context detects misattribution but does not replace sensor parity or authorize PCIe actions. Criteria 1/2/15 are explicit; no hidden 3–14 requirements may be invented.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2014, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, ED-01 through ED-30 and ipmitool/OpenBMC sources were read; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 2015 / Wistron-BMC-01035-V002 / 1e8fb278f2d040a2.
IPMI SDR and sensor lists provide read-only management records, but their names do not inherently identify a physical PCIe branch; an approved root-port-to-endpoint graph is required.
Aggregate switch/riser/slot sensors are valid only when the Project SPEC enumerates their exact physical coverage and applicability; empty or disabled objects need explicit states.
Complete raw IB/OOB lists and all Web pages precede filtering so missing, duplicate, extra or differently named records remain detectable.
The source states SDR, Sensor List and Web SPEC parity; numbering 15 is retained as an editorial defect and supplies no authority to create checks 3–14.
No ipmitool, authentication, sensor or PCIe read, Web login/capture, link reset/retrain/hotplug, log clear, BMC, host or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Physical-topology-bound PCIe management sensor parity across IB/OOB IPMI and BMC Web
test_case.purpose: Verify every required PCIe management sensor is attributed to the correct physical root port/riser/switch/slot/retimer/endpoint and matches the versioned SPEC across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web, with passive link/error context only.
required_package: Exact SUT/BMC/BIOS and versioned PCIe graph from CPU root ports through risers/switches/slots/retimers to installed endpoints, including empty/disabled applicability
PCIe sensor SPEC mapping every required physical object or approved aggregate to IB-SDR/IB-list/OOB-SDR/OOB-list/Web records, units/states/thresholds/update periods
Expected passive enumeration plus negotiated width/speed and allowed baseline AER/error state for correlation
Approved ipmitool/lspci access, trusted protected OOB/Web sessions, aligned sampling and cache/rounding/stale/unavailable/pagination rules
Complete raw/screenshot hashes, preserved AER/OS/BMC logs and human Web/verdict ownership
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; bind exact platform and freeze the approved physical PCIe population/topology. Preserve logs; capture passive enumeration/link/AER baseline without resets or retraining. At aligned times retain complete untruncated IB and OOB `sdr elist`/`sensor list`, then apply the approved per-object/aggregate PCIe crosswalk. Capture every BMC Web Sensor page with physical mapping, target, time and navigation. Compare exact population, name/description/type/unit/reading/state/threshold/freshness with SPEC and across views; correlate but do not substitute passive link width/speed/error evidence. Record N/A only with SPEC proof. Never use the testcase title as a sensor ID, grep/head alone, clear logs, hot-plug, reset/retrain or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every applicable physical PCIe object is represented exactly by its approved individual or aggregate sensor coverage; all mapped IB/OOB/Web fields and time-aligned readings/states meet SPEC, passive enumeration/width/speed remain expected, no new disallowed AER/log condition appears and each N/A is justified.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact topology/population, complete raw IB/OOB and visual Web evidence, complete unique physical-to-sensor coverage and every required field within SPEC/freshness rules plus healthy passive PCIe context. FAIL on unjustified N/A, missing/extra/duplicate/misattributed object, wrong aggregate scope/name/unit/state/threshold, stale/out-of-range value, cross-view mismatch, degraded link/new disallowed error or incomplete evidence. Missing topology/SPEC/crosswalk is NOT READY; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive read-only operations only; prohibit hotplug, link reset/retrain, configuration/sensor/threshold writes and log clearing.
Bind every sensor to an approved physical PCIe object or aggregate after complete raw capture; use protected trusted access.
Stop on topology mismatch, missing/duplicate mapping, degraded width/speed, new AER/fatal error, stale data or wrong target.
No automatic retry; preserve first discrepancy, Web evidence and all OS/BMC/AER logs.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant and SUT/BMC/BIOS identities plus versioned physical PCIe graph/population
Per-object/aggregate five-view sensor SPEC and applicability/crosswalk
Complete timestamped IB/OOB SDR elist and Sensor list raw outputs, exits and hashes
Complete BMC Web screenshots/export with pagination and physical mapping
Passive enumeration/link width-speed/AER context, numbering-defect/no-action/no-clear/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong topology/target, access, mapping, sensor/Web mismatch, degraded link or new AER/log anomaly, stop read-only collection and preserve the first state. Close/revoke sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not hot-plug, retrain/reset, clear evidence or retry insecurely; escalate exact physical path and record IDs to PCIe/BMC owners.

source_conflict.reason: A Project-SPEC physical graph resolves individual/aggregate sensor attribution; all explicit views are preserved and 1/2/15 is an editorial numbering defect, not missing invented coverage.

blocked.reason: Passive topology, sensor/Web comparisons, safety and recovery are defined; exact population/crosswalk/values are runtime Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Exact PCIe physical graph/population, per-object or aggregate sensor SPEC/crosswalk, width-speed/error and freshness/pagination policies, secure evidence ownership.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO PHYSICAL-TOPOLOGY-BOUND READ-ONLY PCIE SENSOR TEST; NO IPMITOOL, AUTHENTICATION, SENSOR/PCIE READ, WEB LOGIN/CAPTURE, LINK ACTION, LOG CLEAR, BMC/HOST OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
